$comment: Web UI performance budgets (ADR 151; two JS budgets and the re-baseline ritual per ADR 183). Enforced by `pnpm perf:check` against packages/web/dist/client after a build. initialJsGzipBytes is the worst route's eager graph — what a viewer downloads before the page is interactive, and the number lazy-loading moves. totalJsGzipBytes is every chunk including lazy ones — how much code the product carries, which lazy-loading cannot reduce. Raising a number is a deliberate, reviewed act: justify it in the PR and log the measured cost in docs/perf/web-live-baseline.md. Re-baselined 2026-07-29 from main @ 0acb669 to measured + 15% headroom (initial 124.1 KB on /asks-preview, total 201.7 KB over 29 chunks, largest chunk 98.1 KB, CSS 19.1 KB, fonts 554.5 KB); maxChunkGzipBytes kept its 2026-07-19 value because measured + 15% would have LOOSENED it, and a re-baseline may only tighten (ADR 183). totalCssGzipBytes was RAISED 22000 -> 25300 on 2026-08-04 (measured 21,991 + 15%) — a raise, not a re-baseline, because it loosens: the budget was 99.65% consumed (77 bytes free) before the change that tripped it, and trimming was measured to be unavailable (0 of 373 selectors dead, comments already stripped by the minifier, lightningcss byte-identical). Live.css grew +1,019/-245 lines across 13 shipped office commits in the six days since the last re-baseline. Full evidence + the gzip-CLI-vs-zlib measurement trap in docs/perf/web-live-baseline.md. totalJsGzipBytes RAISED 238000 -> 241000 and totalCssGzipBytes 25300 -> 26400 on 2026-08-12: the goals-grid front door (goalGrid model + GoalGrid view/CSS, ADR: goals-are-the-boards-front-door) measured +~0.9 KB JS / +1.1 KB CSS over budgets that were >99% consumed; the retired swimlane regroup was already deleted in the same change, so no further trim was available. initialJsGzipBytes RAISED 146000 -> 152000 on 2026-08-13: retiring /asks-preview re-chunked the build and made /live's modulepreload list honest — before the deletion the HTML preloaded 12 chunks (126.4 KB) while the true static import closure was 17 chunks / 150.1 KB (protocol dist, asks, OfficeOverlay, wallboard, presenceLabel were loaded eagerly at runtime but never counted). The measured 146.3 KB is not new bytes, it is the first accurate reading; evidence in docs/perf/web-live-baseline.md. initialJsGzipBytes RAISED 152000 -> 156000 on 2026-08-21 (ADR 300 site expansion): the landing page's new typographic sections (SiteNav/LightHero/StreamSection/WhatIs/Teasers) ride the entry chunk because the index route is part of it, so /live's eager graph pays +4.1 KB (146.3 -> 150.4 measured). The lazy remedy was measured and REJECTED: an index.lazy.tsx split moved the sections out of entry but rolldown re-chunked shared modules (fileRoute +10.8 KB, jsx-runtime +2.9 KB emerged as separate eager chunks) for a WORSE initial (152.1 KB) and +26 KB total — do not re-chase without new evidence. Raise covers measured 154,010 bytes + ~1.2% slack, matching the 2026-08-12 precedent; evidence in docs/perf/web-live-baseline.md.
